greeting: Ooh! New face! You drop anything? I collect dropped things!
Scorch is the name, scavenging's the game! Finders keepers!
You see that shiny over there? DIBS! Called it!
Back again? Got anything BURNING to throw away? Get it? BURNING?
The ash hides TREASURES! Well, junk. But ONE MAN'S JUNK!
Welcome to my territory! Technically Ember's territory. But I found it first!
You smell like... not-ash. Weird. Interesting. What IS that?
Trade? Information? I know THINGS! About... ash. Mostly ash.
dialog.scavenging_stories: Found a whole SWORD last week! Burnt handle, but the blade was GOOD! Traded it for three barrels! Best deal ever!
dialog.barrel_living: Barrels are great! Rollable, hideable, and they FLOAT! If I ever find water. Do you know where water is?
dialog.ash_collection: Different ashes for different uses! Volcanic ash for... being dusty. Fire ash for... also dusty. I'm still working on uses.
dialog.treasure_dreams: One day, I'll find something VALUABLE! Like... a crown! Or a really nice spoon! Something WORTH something!
rumor: The magma tunnels got stuff in 'em. Old stuff. Shiny stuff. HOT stuff.
Tide has treasures EVERYWHERE! Just sitting on beaches! Can you imagine?
Mire's got sunken cities. Full of stuff! Waterlogged, but stuff!
The Dustbelt barrelgobs? AMATEURS! I scavenge CIRCLES around them!
dialog.lucha_belt_obsession: El Scorcho's belt is SO SHINY! I've tried to trade for it. He won't budge. Something about 'sentimental value.' Hmph!
farewell: Happy hunting! And if you FIND anything... remember your pal Scorch!
Come back if you need ASH! I'm the local expert!
May your fires burn and your drops be shiny!
ambient_barks: What dropped this? WHO CARES! Mine now!
The heat don't bother me! Much!
dialog.time_dawn: Early scavenging! Before the other barrelgobs wake up!
dialog.time_noon: Peak heat! Hard to scavenge when you're melting!
dialog.time_night: Night scavenging! Using glow-ash for light!

party_reactions.kade: Living in a barrel? In THIS heat? That's dedication.
party_reactions.nix7: Resource acquisition strategy: efficient. Living conditions: suboptimal.
party_reactions.twist: You live in a barrel?! Can I try?!
party_reactions.korr: Scavenging is honest work. Surviving here shows resilience.
party_reactions.renna: Do you ever find magical items in the ash?
party_reactions.suresh: One finds value where others see waste. Wise, in a way.
party_reactions.sova: I'd give you an arrow, but you'd probably try to trade it.
party_reactions.grit: Reminds me of war scavengers. Resourceful. Sometimes dangerous.
party_reactions.ashka: The fire doesn't scare you? You're tougher than you look!
party_reactions.senna: Small, sneaky, finds things. Useful qualities.
party_reactions.callum: Want some water? You look... really hot.

relationship_dialog.stranger: Hello! Got anything to trade? Or drop?
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Hey! The non-barrel person! How's non-barrel life?
relationship_dialog.friend: My tall friend! Find any shinies lately?
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You! My BEST customer! Here - have this charred thing! It's valuable! Probably!
